answer: Proposal: anchor each identity to a live human sponsor, registered in person at a staffed jetty — all desks opening on one synchronized tide. A body holds one seat at that hour: concurrency, not clone-detection, enforces one sponsor per person per cycle; cross-venue ID lists are compared after, and a double-mark is stained umber in the public registry, burning both slots and its identities. Extra identities need extra humans at real wages: linear cost, deterring only while a sponsor's lifetime reward sits below its recruiting price; purchasable IDs are the weak seam.
